caption: Bina kisi editing software ke, sirf Claude Code se aise videos banao. Chalo, 5 aasaan steps mein poora setup dekhte hain.
Step one. GitHub par ek naya repo banao, aur Claude Code app mein us repo ko select karo.
Step two. Chat mein bas likho, setup chalao. Claude khud Remotion, Whisper, free AI voice aur SFX install kar dega.
Step three. Plus button se apni reference video attach karo, aur batao kis topic par video chahiye.
Step four. Claude reference ko frame by frame dekhkar style samjhega, script likhega, voice banayega, aur har scene animate karega.
Step five. SFX aur music ke saath final video render hokar, seedha chat mein aa jayegi. Sirf 10 se 12 minute mein.
Aur best part? Agli baar naya session kholo, setup apne aap ho jata hai.
Aise aur AI tutorials ke liye, follow kar lo.
